name: kinetix-algo
description: Kinetix Algo — algorithmic trading platform: React terminal, Node/TypeScript engine, simulated and Kotak Neo broker venues.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kinetix/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @kinetix/api && npm run typecheck -w @kinetix/web
